data.name: War of Genesis: Idle Loot
data.detailed_description:
A Small Battlefield in the Corner of Your Desktop

No bulky game window, no cluttered background map. 《The War of Genesis: Idle Loot》 is an idle loot RPG that runs transparently in a small corner of your screen, with no background at all. A 3D character claims its spot on your desktop and fights nonstop, right beside you, no matter what you're doing.

Leave It On and It Grows Stronger

No controls needed. Whether you're working or fast asleep, your character never stops growing.

Trade Your Loot on the Steam Market

Items you farm can be traded with other players on the Steam Community Market.

The Real Fun Is the Loot

Gear pours out with every stage you clear. Weapons, armor, and the random options rolled onto them are the heart of the farming.

Join an Alliance and Grow Together

Team up with your alliance members and take on mighty bosses together in Alliance Raids.

Multiplayer Against Players Worldwide

Take on World Bosses with players across the globe, prove your character in the Arena (PvP), and connect with others in community chat. Leave it running to grow, trade your loot on the Market, and compete with players around the world.

The War of Genesis: Idle Loot. Now, on your desktop.

data.short_description: Just leave it running. The rest takes care of itself. In a small corner of your desktop, a 3D War of Genesis hero fights and loots all on its own. Snag good gear and trade it on the Steam Community Market. It's idle, yet you can't stop watching. Addictive loot at its finest.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GT 1030 / Intel Iris Xe / Radeon Vega 8 or better (DirectX 11 compatible)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / GTX 1650 / Radeon RX 560 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
